The '''Q-2 artificial heart''' was produced by [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]] as part of their [[Cardio-Muscular Package]] designed to enhance a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg's]] [[Heart/Legends|heart]], [[Lung/Legends|lungs]], and muscles. They were [[rybcoarse]]-based.
